# Duplicates {#sec-duplicate} ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ::: It is very easy when inputting data to make mistakes, copy something in twice for example, or if someone did a lot of copy-pasting to assemble a spreadsheet (yikes!). We can check this pretty quickly ## Duplicated rows ::: {.panel-tabset} ## dplyr ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} # check for whole duplicate # rows in the data penguins |> filter(duplicated(across(everything()))) sum() ``` ::: ``` [1] 0 ``` ## janitor ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} library(janitor) penguins |> get_dupes() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display}

If I did have duplications I could investigate further and extract these exact rows: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} # Inspect duplicated rows penguins |> filter(duplicated(across(everything()))) ``` ::: ``` A tibble:0 × 17 0 rows | 1-8 of 17 columns ``` ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} # Keep only unduplicated data with ! penguins |> filter(!duplicated(across(everything()))) ``` ::: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ::: {.cell-output-display}
